# IFontStyle.Properties — interface<C = IColor.Serializable> · 13 members
The stored shape of a text style.

- `family?: string` — A family name, or a ThemeFamily.
- `fallbacks?: string[]` — Returns the families drawn when IFontStyle.getFamily cannot draw a character, in order.
- `size?: number` — Returns the size in points.
- `weight?: number` — Returns the weight, `400` being regular and `700` bold.
- `style?: IFont.Style` — `italic` or `normal`.
- `color?: C` — Returns the text color.
- `letterSpacing?: number` — Returns the space added between characters, in points; `0` for none, negative to condense.
- `underline?: IFont.UnderlineStyle` — Returns how the text is underlined; `'none'` when it is not.
- `strike?: IFont.StrikeStyle` — Returns how the text is struck through; `'none'` when it is not.
- `baseline?: number` — Returns how far the text is raised, as a percentage of its size: positive for superscript, negative for subscript, `0` on the baseline.
- `charset?: number` — The character set the font was authored against, a font-substitution hint.
- `shadow?: boolean`
- `outline?: boolean`
